Click any **building or character** to open its wiki entry.
**Drag** to pan along the street, **scroll** to zoom. Arrow keys work too.
Use **⟲ Other side** to swing the camera around — Jimmy Pesto's is over there, watching.
Open **📺 Episodes** to watch an episode play out as a walk across the map.
The URL updates as you explore — **share a link** and it drops friends exactly where you are.
Every building, character, and episode here is a **JSON manifest** plus procedural voxel art. Add your own with a pull request — no engine code required.
Coming eventually: a full **continuity timeline** and Wonder Wharf down the street.
This site is **100% static**: the GitHub repo is the backend, and pull requests are the moderation queue.
